sentences.en: MAN: Hello, Steynford College external course registration, can I help you?
sentences.zh: MAN: 你好，这里是斯泰恩福德学院校外课程注册处，有什么可以帮您的吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah, I'm ringing to find out about one-day classes next year. I got a leaflet about them in the post but I lost it, and I understand some of the classes are filling up fast, so I might need to book quite soon if I want to go ahead.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，我打电话来想了解一下明年的一日课程。我之前收到过一份关于这些课程的宣传单，但弄丢了；而且我听说有些课程名额正迅速报满，所以如果我想报名的话，可能得尽快预订。

sentences.en: MAN: Sure. Can you remember which one you were considering?
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的。您还记得自己考虑的是哪一门课吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: There were a few actually. I remember there was one on how to make Vietnamese food that sounded good. I think that was on the 13th of January.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 实际上有好几门。我记得有一门是教如何制作越南菜的，听起来不错，好像是在1月13日。

sentences.en: MAN: It cost about 60 pounds.
sentences.zh: MAN: 费用大约是60英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, you're right about the date, but it's 59 pounds actually. It's a very popular class, and among other things the teacher explains how Vietnamese food includes lots of different herbs. I'm afraid that all the places are taken at present, but I can put you on the waiting list if you want?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 您说的日期没错，但实际费用是59英镑。这门课非常热门，老师还会讲解越南菜中大量使用各种香草的特点。很抱歉，目前所有名额均已报满，不过如果您愿意，我可以把您加入候补名单。

sentences.en: MAN: No, that's OK. I'm quite interested in the bread making class. That's in March sometime, isn't it?
sentences.zh: MAN: 不用了，谢谢。我对面包制作课挺感兴趣的，那门课应该是在三月某个时候，对吧？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah, the 20th of March. Would you like to register for that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，是3月20日。您要登记报名这门课吗？

sentences.en: MAN: I'm not sure. How much is it?
sentences.zh: MAN: 我还不确定。费用是多少？

sentences.en: WOMAN: The actual cost is £48 but then there's an extra charge as well as that for the ingredients - I'm not sure how much that is, no more than twenty pounds I think.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 课程本身费用是48英镑，此外还需额外支付食材费——具体金额我不太确定，但应该不会超过20英镑。

sentences.en: MAN: So what sorts of things do they make in the class?
sentences.zh: MAN: 那么课堂上主要制作哪些种类的面包呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh, various types of bread; I think they make white bread and then they make sourdough, that seems to be very fashionable at present, and they learn how to make pizza, which is apparently really good.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 哦，各种类型的面包；比如白面包，还有酸面团面包——目前这种面包特别流行，另外他们还会学习制作披萨，据说味道真的很好。

sentences.en: MAN: Well I'd definitely be interested in that, but there were also a few other classes that sounded interesting. I think there was one on face massage? I'd love to learn how to do that.
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，这门课我肯定感兴趣，不过还有几门其他课程听起来也很有意思。我记得好像有一门面部按摩课？我很想学这个。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah, that's on the 23rd of February and it costs just £35 for the day. The teacher's great, the type of massage done is a traditional technique used in India and she actually did her training there. The massage is meant to relax you and get rid of lines and wrinkles. You practise it on yourself so you have to take a mirror to the class, so you can see what you're doing.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对，这门课安排在2月23日，全天费用仅为35英镑。授课老师非常优秀，所教授的按摩手法是一种源自印度的传统技术，她本人就在印度接受过专业培训。这种按摩旨在帮助放松身心，并减轻细纹和皱纹。学员需自行练习，因此上课时需要自带一面镜子，以便观察自己的操作。

sentences.en: WOMAN: OK.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的。

sentences.en: MAN: And I think there was a class in candle making?
sentences.zh: MAN: 还有一门蜡烛制作课，我也记得有。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes that's sometime in April, I think. Let me check... yes, it's on the 6th. It was on the 23rd of January but they had to change the date. It's just £52. That's a popular course too. I think one reason why people like it is because the candles are all made out of natural products. It's filling up fast but there's still a few places left.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是的，这门课安排在四月的某个时间，让我查一下……对，是4月6日。原定于1月23日举行，但后来更改了日期。费用仅为52英镑。这也是一个热门课程，人们喜欢它的原因之一在于所有蜡烛均采用天然原料制成。目前报名进展很快，但尚余少量名额。

sentences.en: MAN: Yes one of my friends did that class. She said the candles make really good presents. In fact she gave me one.
sentences.zh: MAN: 是的，我有个朋友参加过这门课。她说这些蜡烛特别适合作为礼物，事实上她还送了我一支。

sentences.en: WOMAN: By the way, have you heard about the class on silk painting? That's being held on the 18th of May. You learn how to create designs on silk fabric and colour them using special dyes. Apparently people can produce beautiful artworks that way, either to put on the wall as a picture or to use for something like a scarf.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 对了，您听说过丝巾绘画课吗？这门课将于5月18日举办。您将学习如何在真丝面料上创作图案，并使用特制染料为其上色。据称，人们能借此创作出精美的艺术作品，既可作为装饰画挂在墙上，也可制成围巾等实用物品。

sentences.en: MAN: It's £67.50, which is really good value I think - there's a similar class I've seen that was £110.
sentences.zh: MAN: 费用是67.50英镑，我觉得性价比非常高——我见过类似课程收费高达110英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That sounds interesting. Would I need to bring the silk?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 听起来很有趣。我需要自带丝绸吗？

sentences.en: MAN: No, the only thing is everyone has to bring something to protect their clothing, like an apron if you've got one, or a shirt that you don't use any more, because the dye can really stain your clothes.
sentences.zh: MAN: 不用，唯一的要求是每位学员都得带件能保护衣服的东西，比如围裙（如果你有的话），或者一件你不再穿的旧衬衫，因为染料很容易弄脏衣服。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Right. Then the last class I was considering was a bit different, that was on DIY for beginners. I'd like to learn how to do household repairs. Are there any places left on that?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 明白了。然后我考虑的最后一门课有点不同，是面向初学者的DIY课程。我想学些家居维修技能。这门课还有空位吗？

sentences.en: MAN: That's on the 24th of February - yes, there are a few places. It's a bit more expensive - it's £125 - but it's a very popular class. You learn how to use an electric drill and a saw.
sentences.zh: MAN: 这门课在2月24日开课——对，还有几个空位。费用稍高一些，为125英镑，但非常热门。你会学习如何使用电钻和锯子。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yeah, that would be really useful, and I even need to learn how to use a hammer because I always end up hitting my fingers.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 是啊，这确实非常实用；而且我甚至还得学怎么用锤子，因为我总是一不小心就砸到自己的手指。

sentences.en: Yes, you'll do that too. And when you've learned how to use the basic tools, you do a practical job which is fixing a shelf to a wall.
sentences.zh: 是的，这门课也会教。等你掌握了基本工具的使用方法后，还要完成一项实操任务：把一个搁板固定到墙上。

sentences.en: Great. Just what I need to know. Right, well I'd like to enrol for that and also for
sentences.zh: 太好了，这正是我需要掌握的内容。好的，那我想报名这门课，另外也想报……
